column2: [wizard.GetTitledFirstName] has agreed to hear what you want made. The workshop smells of brimstone and hot metal, and every table is covered in half-finished things: a ring cooling in a dish of quicksilver, a blade wrapped in written prayers, a row of stoppered flasks that glow faintly in the dark.\n\n"Gold and the winds of magic, my [Root.GetLordLady]. You bring the first, I bring the second. The richer the purse and the stronger the mage, the finer the work. What shall it be?"
A blade.
An amulet of protection.
A potion.
Show me the rings and elixirs.
Rings are small work, but they last. Elixirs are poured into the blood and stay there. Neither is cheap.
A ring.
An elixir.
Never mind.
A blade takes longer than anything else I make. The steel must be folded with the spell inside it, one layer at a time, and the greater the spell, the more years it takes.
Show me the greater blades.
An amulet turns aside blades and arrows, and in battle its ward can be stretched over the men around you for a few moments. The stronger the ward, the longer I need.
A potion is gone once it is drunk, but some potions do things nothing else can. The last on my list is not something I offer lightly.
Which ring would you have?
An elixir sharpens one gift of the mind for the rest of your life. Choose the one you need most.
Runesword (1 year)
Sword of Ice (2 years)
Sword of Fire (3 years)
Sword of Lightning (4 years)

Amulet of Protection +3 (3 years)
Amulet of Protection +5 (5 years)

If the mage agrees, the work will take a year.
If the mage agrees, the work will take two years.
If the mage agrees, the work will take three years.
If the mage agrees, the work will take four years.
If the mage agrees, the work will take five years.
If the mage agrees, the work will take ten years.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] reminds you, politely, that you are still waiting for the last thing you ordered. One commission at a time, my [Root.GetLordLady].
I will wait.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has turned down your commission.
Very well.
I will make it.
Find another mage.
Excellent!
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Runesword, a plain blade that will never break or dull. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.

[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Sword of Ice, with the cold of the north folded into the steel. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.

[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Sword of Fire, the kind of blade the Bright College is famous for. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Sword of Lightning, with a storm bound in the edge. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.

[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Sword of Destruction, the greatest blade you know how to make. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a small Amulet of Protection. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a strong Amulet of Protection. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make the strongest Amulet of Protection you can make. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.

[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Potion of Healing, against the day the surgeons give up. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.

[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Potion of Beauty, since nothing else seems to work at court. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.

[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make an Elixir of Eternal Youth. Even for a mage of your power that is ten years of work, and it will cost [buyer.GetHerHim] a fortune. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Ring of Persuasion. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Ring of Invisibility. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Ring of Speed. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make a Ring of Command. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make an elixir to make [buyer.GetHerHim] a better commander. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.

[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make an elixir to make [buyer.GetHerHim] a better steward of [buyer.GetHerHis] lands. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make an elixir to sweeten [buyer.GetHerHis] tongue. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.
[buyer.GetTitledFirstName] wants you to make an elixir to sharpen [buyer.GetHerHis] eye for plots. [buyer.GetSheHeCap] will pay you well from the price, and the work will teach you something too.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] lays a sword before you, its blade covered in runes that glow when you touch the grip. It will not break and it will not dull, and it will serve your house long after you are gone.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] lays a sword before you, so cold that frost forms on the scabbard. In battle it can loose a blast of ice that freezes men where they stand.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] lays a sword before you. When you draw it, flames run along the edge, and your men cheer and your enemies fall back from the heat.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] lays a sword before you, humming like the air before a storm. It cuts through mail like cloth and calls lightning down on the enemy line.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] lays a sword before you, and the room falls silent. The power bound in it is almost too much to hold. In battle it will throw men into the air like leaves, and songs will be sung about it.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] hangs a small amulet around your neck. It will turn aside a blow or two, and for a few moments in battle its ward can be stretched over the men around you.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] hangs an amulet of silver and amber around your neck. Arrows will bend away from you, and in battle its ward can shelter the men around you.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] hangs a heavy amulet around your neck, warm to the touch. Five years of spells are woven into it. Blades slide off you, and in battle the ward can cover a whole regiment for a while.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] hands you a small flask of red liquid. Drunk at the right moment, it will close any wound and mend any break. It will work only once.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] hands you a flask that smells of roses. You drink it, and the mirror already shows a change.
After ten long years, [From.GetTitledFirstName] hands you a single flask of golden liquid. The spell is tied to your blood: no one else can drink it, and time will touch you more lightly from now on.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] slips a ring onto your finger. Charm magic and a sharper ear for the turn of a conversation will make every negotiation go your way.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] slips a ring onto your finger. When you turn it, people stop noticing you. It is hard to think of anything more useful at court.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] slips a ring onto your finger, and suddenly everyone else seems slow. In war its power can be stretched over the men who follow you.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] slips a heavy golden ring onto your finger. When you speak, soldiers obey before they have thought about it, and your captains say you have never been a better [Root.GetMarshalName].
[From.GetTitledFirstName] hands you a flask of something dark and bitter. You drink, and the art of war seems clearer than ever.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] hands you a flask of something pale and clear. You drink, and ledgers and harvest counts that used to bore you now make sense.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] hands you a flask of something sweet. You drink, and the right words come to you as easily as breathing.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] hands you a flask of something that tastes of nothing at all. You drink, and every lie told at your court sounds false to you.
